title: Tailored Internet-delivered Cognitive Behaviour Therapy for Symptoms of Depression and Comorbid Problems
brief_summary: The overall aim of this study is to develop and test a tailored Internet-delivered psychological treatment for patients with mild to moderate major depression and comorbid anxiety symptoms and compare its efficacy to a non-tailored treatment and to an active control group.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of Major Depressive Disorder
* 15 or more on MADRS-S

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe depression (more than 35 on MADRS-S or based on interview)
* Severe psychiatric condition (e.g. psychosis or bipolar disorder)
* Changed medication during the last three months
